name: East African Community (1967–1977)

colors.symbolism: Lake Victoria and the Indian Ocean

description: A green field with three red stars toward the hoist at top; across the lower middle run narrow black, yellow and red stripes separated by white, above a light-blue base.
history: Flag of the first East African Community, the common-market organization of Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania founded in 1967 and dissolved in 1977. The three stars stood for the three member states; the community was revived under a new flag in 2000.

features.role: green field over narrow black, yellow and red stripes and a light-blue base

features.symbolism: the three member states: Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania
